title: Basic Commands [Special paths and ls]
description:
# Ls and ../.
## Special paths:

---
There are 2 special paths in Linux, '..' and '.'.
.. means the previous directory, so `cd ..` in `~` would take you to `/home/`
. means the current directory.

---
## ls

---
`ls` stands for list. It lists all files at the path, so `ls .` lists all files in the current directory. Another important flag is -1. This will make it so only one file is outputed per line.

---
